title: Distinct Profiles of Run-to-Run Score Reliability and Expert-Panel Alignment Across Four LLM Evaluators of Simulated Japanese-Language AI-to-AI Counseling
abstract: arXiv:2507.02950v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly evaluate generated dialogue, but repeatable scores do not necessarily align with professional judgment. This observational fixed-benchmark study compared four configured LLM evaluator systems (GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Claude Opus 4.8, and Fable 5) with aggregated ratings from 15 counseling experts on 18 complete simulated AI-to-AI counseling sessions conducted in Japanese. The sessions represented three counselor conditions across six prespecified client profiles. Each system scored every transcript three times on four motivational interviewing-informed dimensions and overall quality. All four systems assigned higher scores than the expert panel for softening sustain talk and overall quality, although differences varied across systems and constructs. translated_title: 四种大语言模型评估器对日语模拟AI对AI咨询的逐次评分信度与专家小组一致性不同特征
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于评估生成的对话，但可重复的分数不一定与专业判断一致。这项观察性固定基准研究比较了四种配置的LLM评估系统（GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Claude Opus 4.8和Fable 5）与15位咨询专家对18次完整的日语模拟AI对AI咨询会话的汇总评分。这些会话代表了三种咨询师条件，覆盖六个预设客户画像。每个系统对每份转录文本在四个基于动机性访谈的维度和整体质量上进行了三次评分。所有四个系统在软化维持谈话和整体质量方面给出的分数均高于专家小组，尽管差异因系统和构念而异。单次运行的组内相关系数范围为0.33到0.96，表明高逐次运行信度并不确保更接近专家评分。
tldr: 本研究揭示了四种LLM评估器在日语AI咨询评估中，高逐次评分信度并不等同于与专家判断一致，所有系统均倾向于给出高于专家的分数。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that high run-to-run reliability of four LLM evaluators in Japanese AI counseling assessments does not ensure alignment with expert judgment, as all systems tended to score higher than experts.
